title: 🦒 At the Zoo & Present Simple (вопросы с do/does)

days.title: Day 1: Zoo Animals
days.description: Знакомимся с животными зоопарка — жирафами, обезьянами, медведями и другими

grammar.title: Present Simple: вопросы с do/does
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как задать вопрос о животном?**

✅ **Do** + I/you/we/they + глагол?
❓ Do tigers eat meat? — Yes, they do.

✅ **Does** + he/she/it + глагол?
❓ Does a giraffe eat meat? — No, it doesn't.

📝 **Краткие ответы**:
✅ Yes, I/you/we/they do.
✅ Yes, he/she/it does.
❌ No, I/you/we/they don't.
❌ No, he/she/it doesn't.

vocabulary.example: Giraffes have got very long necks.
Lions are the kings of the jungle.

exercises.question: Which animal has got a very long neck? 🦒
exercises.explanation: Giraffes have got very long necks! 🦒

exercises.question: ___ monkeys live in trees? — Yes, they do. 🐒
exercises.explanation: Monkeys — they (множественное число) → Do they? 🐒

exercises.question: Penguins can fly.
exercises.explanation: Penguins can't fly! They can swim very well! 🐧

exercises.question: ___ a peacock have got a beautiful tail? 🦚
exercises.explanation: A peacock — he/she/it (один) → Does it? 🦚

exercises.question: Do a crocodile live in water?
exercises.correct: Does a crocodile live in water?
accept: Does a crocodile live in water
does a crocodile live in water
exercises.explanation: A crocodile — один (it) → Does it live? 🐊

days.title: Day 2: Describing Zoo Animals
days.description: Учимся описывать животных зоопарка — какой они формы и размера

grammar.title: Вопросы: What does it look like?
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как спросить, как выглядит животное?**

❓ **What does it look like?** — Как оно выглядит?

✅ **Ответ**: It has got + части тела.

🎯 **Примеры**:
❓ What does a giraffe look like?
✅ It has got a long neck and long legs.

❓ What does a penguin look like?
✅ It has got black and white feathers.

It has got black and white feathers.

exercises.explanation: Giraffes have got long necks and long legs! 🦒

exercises.question: What ___ a penguin look like? 🐧
exercises.explanation: A penguin — один (it) → What does it look like? 🐧

grammar.title: Диалог: At the Zoo
grammar.rule:
📘 **Полезные фразы для зоопарка**:

❓ What's that animal over there? — Что это за животное там?
❓ What does it look like? — Как оно выглядит?
❓ Do you like monkeys? — Тебе нравятся обезьяны?
✅ Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

📝 **Выражения эмоций**:
😍 They are so beautiful!
😱 I don't like them. They are noisy.

vocabulary.example: Look! That animal over there is a lion.
vocabulary.context_example: Смотри! Вон там животное — это лев.

vocabulary.example: Let's go and see the bears.

exercises.question: What do you say when you see an animal far away? 👀
exercises.explanation: You ask 'What's that animal over there?' when you see something far away! 👀

exercises.question: ___ you like monkeys? 🐒 — Yes, I do.
exercises.explanation: You — множественное число → Do you like? 🐒

exercises.question: Monkeys are quiet animals.
exercises.explanation: Monkeys are NOISY, not quiet! 🐒🔊

exercises.question: Peacocks are so ___ ! 🦚 (beautiful / noisy)
exercises.explanation: Peacocks are beautiful with their colourful feathers! 🦚

exercises.question: Let's go and see the bears. — OK.
exercises.explanation: This dialogue is correct! Let's go see the bears! 🐻

days.title: Day 4: Reading — A Day at the Zoo
days.description: Читаем историю о дне в зоопарке

grammar.title: Чтение и понимание текста
grammar.rule:
📚 **Стратегия чтения**:
1️⃣ Прочитай текст целиком, чтобы понять общий смысл.
2️⃣ Найди названия животных и их описания.
3️⃣ Прочитай вопросы и найди ответы в тексте.

💡 **Совет**: Обрати внимание на вопросы с do/does!

exercises.question: Where did Leo, Mia and Sam go? 🏞️
exercises.explanation: They went to the zoo! 🏞️
exercises.readingText:
🌟 A DAY AT THE ZOO 🌟

Leo, Mia and Sam went to the zoo on Saturday. It was a sunny day and they were very excited!

🦒 FIRST STOP: GIRAFFES

Leo: 'Look at the giraffes! They have got such long necks!'

Mia: 'What do giraffes eat? Do they eat meat?'

Leo: 'No, they don't. They eat leaves from trees.'

Sam: 'That makes sense! They need a long neck to reach the leaves!' 🦒

🐒 SECOND STOP: MONKEYS

Sam: 'Look at the monkeys! They are so funny!'

Mia: 'Do you like monkeys, Sam?'

Sam: 'Yes, I do! They are very cute. But they are so noisy!'

Leo: 'I don't like monkeys. They are too loud and they steal everything!' 🐒

🐻 THIRD STOP: BEARS

Leo: 'Let's go and see the bears!'

Mia: 'What do bears look like?'

Sam: 'They are big and they have got thick fur. They eat fish and berries.'

Leo: 'Do bears sleep in winter?'

Sam: 'Yes, they do. They hibernate!' 🐻

🐧 FOURTH STOP: PENGUINS

Mia: 'Penguins are my favourite! They are black and white and they can swim very well!'

Leo: 'Do penguins live in the Arctic?'

Sam: 'No, they don't. They live in Antarctica!'

Mia: 'I want to see them in real life one day!' 🐧

🦚 LAST STOP: PEACOCKS

Leo: 'Wow! Peacocks are so beautiful! Look at their colourful tails!'

Sam: 'Do they use their tails to fly?'

Mia: 'No, they don't. They use them to attract females!'

Leo: 'That's interesting!' 🦚

🔙 ON THE WAY HOME

Mia: 'That was the best day ever!'

Sam: 'What was your favourite animal?'

Leo: 'The giraffe. It's so elegant!'

Mia: 'My favourite is the penguin. They are so cute!'

Sam: 'I liked the monkeys. They are so funny and clever!' 🐒

💬 What's YOUR favourite zoo animal? 👇

days.title: Day 5: Present Simple Questions Practice
days.description: Тренируем вопросы с do/does о животных

grammar.title: Present Simple — вопросы и ответы
grammar.rule:
📘 **Ещё раз вопросы с do/does**:

❓ **Do** + I/you/we/they + глагол?
✅ Do tigers eat meat? — Yes, they do.

❓ **Does** + he/she/it + глагол?
✅ Does a tiger eat meat? — Yes, it does.

📝 **Отрицательные ответы**:
❌ No, they don't.
❌ No, it doesn't.

🎯 **Примеры**:
❓ Do penguins live in Russia?
❌ No, they don't. They live in Antarctica.

❓ Does a giraffe have a short neck?
❌ No, it doesn't. It has a long neck.

exercises.question: ___ tigers eat meat? 🐯
exercises.explanation: Tigers — they (множественное число) → Do they eat? 🐯

exercises.question: ___ a penguin swim well? 🐧 — Yes, it does.
exercises.explanation: A penguin — один (it) → Does it swim? 🐧

exercises.question: Do peacocks eat meat? — Yes, they do.
exercises.explanation: Peacocks eat seeds and insects, not meat! 🦚

exercises.question: ___ a bear eat fish? 🐻 — Yes, it does.
exercises.explanation: A bear — один (it) → Does it eat fish? 🐻🐟

exercises.question: Does monkeys live in trees?
exercises.explanation: Monkeys — they (множественное число) → Do they live? 🐒

days.title: Day 6: Writing — My Favourite Zoo Animal
days.description: Пишем текст о любимом животном в зоопарке

grammar.title: Повторение: описание животного
grammar.rule:
📚 **План для письма**:

1️⃣ What is the animal? (Название животного)
2️⃣ What does it look like? (Как выглядит?)
3️⃣ Where does it live? (Где живёт?)
4️⃣ What does it eat? (Что ест?)
5️⃣ Why do you like it? (Почему ты его любишь?)

🎯 **Пример**:
My favourite zoo animal is the penguin. It has got black and white feathers. It lives in Antarctica. It eats fish. I like it because it is cute and can swim very well! 🐧

exercises.explanation: Напиши название своего любимого животного! 🐧

exercises.explanation: Опиши, как выглядит твоё животное! 🎨

exercises.explanation: Где живёт твоё животное? 🌍

exercises.explanation: Что ест твоё животное? 🍖

exercises.question: I like it because it is ___ and ___ . (напиши два прилагательных)
exercises.explanation: Почему тебе нравится это животное? Напиши два слова! 💖
